basis: one fixture, separate from per-module materials

items.description: 4-point crown spring probe; candidate only
Prewired 1000mm green AWG30 solid-wire receptacle; candidate only

Machined FR-4 support carrier 36.6 x 54 x 5 mm: 7 through windows over the probe field and every B-face part and lead (internal radius 1.0 mm, walls and webs at least 1.0 mm), 3 datum pin holes 2.0 mm (press fit), 2 dowel holes 2.0 mm, 6 M3 holes countersunk 90 degrees to 6.0 mm, 2 guide-standoff holes 3.4 mm; geometry in fixture-assembly.step and manifest.json; fabricator not selected

Machined FR-4 probe plate 36.6 x 54 x 6 mm: 5 receptacle bores 0.99 mm (finished 0.98-1.00 mm, drilled, 0.40 mm web at the 1.4 mm test-point pitch), one J5 lead window (internal radius 1.1 mm), 2 dowel holes 2.0 mm, 6 M3 holes 3.4 mm; no component pockets
Machined FR-4 pressure plate 37.2 x 10.5 x 3 mm: J5 notch (radius 0.8 mm), 2 guide holes 6.6 mm, 3 M2 tapped holes (1.6 mm drill)
Machined FR-4 base plate 36.6 x 54 x 3 mm: 6 M3 holes countersunk to 6.0 mm, cable-tie slot 4 x 2 mm (radius 0.8 mm)
Dowel pins 2.0 x 6 mm, hardened steel, press fit in the carrier, 1.0 mm above the carrier top: X1, X2 on the x = 16.2 board edge, Y1 on the y = 62.9 edge
Dowel pins 2.0 x 16 mm, hardened steel m6, through probe plate and carrier (D1, D2) from the probe-plate underside, ending 1.0 mm below the carrier top, aligning the bores to the datum pins
M3 x 8 countersunk screws (ISO 10642 / DIN 7991), carrier top flush
M3 hex spacers female-female 6 mm, 5.5 mm across flats, between carrier and probe plate
M3 x 12 set screws used as studs through the probe plate
M3 hex standoffs female-female 35 mm, 5.5 mm across flats, between probe plate and base plate
M3 x 8 countersunk screws (DIN 7991 / ISO 10642), base underside flush, 5 mm into the 35 mm standoff thread
M3 hex standoffs female-female 20 mm, 5.5 mm across flats, 7 mm thread each end, on the carrier top (G1, G2), fixed by M3 x 8 socket head screws from below
M3 x 8 socket head screws (ISO 4762) under the carrier and M3 x 6 socket head screws on the standoff tops
DIN 9021 M3 washers, 9 mm OD, 0.8 mm

Compression springs over the guide standoffs: work over a rod of at least 6.35 mm (hex corners) with inner diameter at least 6.6 mm, outer diameter at most 9.2 mm, 6.35-10.0 N each over installed length 12.6-13.2 mm (worst case with rate and free-length tolerances), solid length at most 12.3 mm (total at least 12.7 N = 2.0 x the 6.35 N probe force at maximum stroke; at most 20 N keeps the board bending within its limit)
M2 x 8 nylon (PA66) pan head screws in the pressure plate, tip 2.5 +/-0.1 mm below the plate, locked by an M2 nylon nut
M2 nylon (PA66) hex nuts
Cable tie through the base-plate slot and TP1-TP5 labels on both ends of the five green receptacle leads

blockers: No fixture part is selected: plates are digital designs and hardware lines are requirements. manifest.json#hardware_proposal lists one sourced candidate per line as a proposal awaiting owner approval; fabricator and supplier are owner choices.
Probe-plate bores leave 0.40 mm between bores at the fixed 1.4 mm test-point pitch: within the INGUN grid, below the 1.0 mm milled-wall guidance; the chosen fabricator must confirm drilling it.
No current price, MOQ, lead time or availability retrieved; no supplier-upload package.
